derived_components.description: O*NET-SOC code and title, job zone, top-5 knowledge / essential-skill / work-activity elements by Importance (IM, ratings flagged Recommend Suppress excluded), and core/supplemental task counts. No occupation descriptions or task statement text.

DreamCo capability-lens scores (mean IM of DreamCo-grouped 4.A.* elements, rescaled 0-1), lift over the all-occupation lens mean, dominant lens (largest lift), knowledge lens (largest lift of top knowledge elements over all-occupation element means), preparation band and data-confidence band (dates, N, suppressed count, rating sources). DreamCo method over O*NET® values.
Template-generated DreamCo practice seed, rubric dimensions and agree/caveat/improve/still-need-test analysis. Embeds O*NET® titles and element names, so the O*NET® attribution still applies.

transformation_history.step: verify db_31_0_csv.zip sha256 against provenance_manifest.json pin; read 6 CSV members in memory
select 2 data-level occupations per SOC major group (sha256 seed 'dp-onet-occ-syn-0.0.2'), derive rows, render cards
